premise: Beaver wants a band: Woodpecker drums on a trunk, Pinecone rattles her scales, Bee hums, Frog croaks — all at different speeds — and Beaver's slow scritch-scratch gnawing turns out to be the rhythm that holds them together.
inspiration: The Bremen Town Musicians (Grimm), turned: nobody has to travel to be a band, and the odd one out keeps the time.
lesson: The quiet one can be the one everyone needs.

en-US.title: The Meadow Band
en-US.text: [excited] {beaver:enter} Beaver wanted a band. A real meadow band! {beaver:face happy} {beaver:hop} "Who can play?" he called. {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Woodpecker landed on a tree trunk. "I can drum!" {woodpecker:live drum} {sfx:drum} Rat-a-tat-TAT! {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to beaver} Pinecone came rolling up. "I can shake!" {pinecone:live rattle} Shh-shh went her scales. {bee:enter} {bee:go to beaver} Bee came buzzing over. "I can hum!" {bee:live hum} Mmm-mmm. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} And from beside the pond, Frog called, "CROAK!" [curious] "What do you play, Beaver?" {beaver:face sad} Beaver looked at his stick. "I just gnaw," he said. So they played. Rat-a-tat! Shh-shh! Mmm! CROAK! {all:face surprised} {all:wobble} All at once, and all at different speeds. [laughs] What a jumble! Beaver sat down with a sigh and {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} gnawed. Scritch, scratch. Scritch, scratch. Slow and steady. {woodpecker:live drum} Woodpecker drummed along. {pinecone:pulse} Pinecone shook along. {frog:hop} Frog croaked along, and Bee hummed along. {all:face happy} [excited] It was music! {canvas:confetti} {all:hop x2} "Hooray for the band!" [happily] And its name? The Scritch-Scratch Band, of course.

es-ES.title: La banda del prado
es-ES.text: [excited] {beaver:enter} Castor quería una banda. ¡Una banda del prado de verdad! {beaver:face happy} {beaver:hop} —¿Quién sabe tocar? —preguntó. {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pájaro carpintero se posó en un tronco. —¡Yo toco el tambor! {woodpecker:live drum} {sfx:drum} ¡Ra-ta-ta-TÁ! {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to beaver} Piña llegó rodando. —¡Yo hago de maraca! {pinecone:live rattle} Chis-chas, sonaron sus escamas. {bee:enter} {bee:go to beaver} Abeja llegó zumbando. —¡Yo tarareo! {bee:live hum} Mmm-mmm. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Y desde la orilla de la charca, Rana cantó: —¡CROAC! [curious] —¿Y tú qué tocas, Castor? {beaver:face sad} Castor miró su palo. —Yo solo sé roer —dijo. Así que se pusieron a tocar. ¡Ra-ta-tá! ¡Chis-chas! ¡Mmm! ¡CROAC! {all:face surprised} {all:wobble} Todos a la vez, y cada uno a su aire. [laughs] ¡Menudo lío! Castor se sentó con un suspiro y {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} se puso a roer. Ric, rac. Ric, rac. Despacito y sin parar. {woodpecker:live drum} Carpintero le siguió el ritmo. {pinecone:pulse} Y Piña. {frog:hop} Y Rana, y Abeja. {all:face happy} [excited] ¡Aquello era música! {canvas:confetti} {all:hop x2} —¡Viva la banda! [happily] ¿Y cómo se llama? La banda Ric-Rac, claro.

ja-JP.title: のはらの カリコリバンド
ja-JP.text: [excited]{beaver:enter}ビーバーくんは、バンドがやりたくなりました。のはらのバンドです！{beaver:face happy}{beaver:hop}「えんそうできるの、だあれ？」 {woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}キツツキくんが木のみきにとまって、「ぼく、たいこ！」 {woodpecker:live drum}{sfx:drum}タタタタ、タン！{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to beaver}まつぼっくりが、ころころころ。「わたし、マラカス！」 {pinecone:live rattle}かさが、シャカシャカ。{bee:enter}{bee:go to beaver}ミツバチさんも、ぶーん。「わたしは、はなうた！」 {bee:live hum}ふんふーん。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}池のそばからは、カエルさんが「ゲコッ！」 [curious]「ビーバーくんは、なにをするの？」 {beaver:face sad}ビーバーくんは、ぼうを見つめて「ぼく、かじるだけ…」 さあ、えんそう！タタタ！シャカシャカ！ふんふん！ゲコッ！{all:face surprised}{all:wobble}みんないっぺんに、ばらばらのはやさで。[laughs]なんて、ごちゃごちゃ！ビーバーくんは、ふうっとすわって、{beaver:live gnaw}{sfx:gnaw}かじりはじめました。カリ、コリ。カリ、コリ。ゆっくり、こつこつ。{woodpecker:live drum}キツツキくんが、あわせてタタン。{pinecone:pulse}まつぼっくりも、シャカシャカ。{frog:hop}カエルさんもゲコッ、ミツバチさんもふんふん。{all:face happy}[excited]おんがくに、なった！{canvas:confetti}{all:hop x2}「バンド、ばんざい！」 [happily]なまえは？もちろん、カリコリバンド！

de-DE.title: Die Wiesenband
de-DE.text: [excited] {beaver:enter} Der Biber wollte eine Band. Eine richtige Wiesenband! {beaver:face happy} {beaver:hop} „Wer kann Musik machen?“, rief er. {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Der Specht landete an einem dicken Stamm. „Ich kann trommeln!“ {woodpecker:live drum} {sfx:drum} Tock-tock-tock-TOCK! {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to beaver} Der Tannenzapfen kam angerollt. „Ich kann rasseln!“ {pinecone:live rattle} Tschick-tschick, machten seine Schuppen. {bee:enter} {bee:go to beaver} Die Biene kam herbeigesummt. „Ich kann summen!“ {bee:live hum} Summ-summ. Und vom Teich her rief {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} der Frosch: „KOAX!“ [curious] „Und was spielst du, Biber?“ {beaver:face sad} Der Biber schaute seinen Stock an. „Ich kann nur nagen“, sagte er. Also spielten sie los. Tock-tock! Tschick-tschick! Summ! KOAX! {all:face surprised} {all:wobble} Alle auf einmal, und jeder in seinem eigenen Tempo. [laughs] Was für ein Durcheinander! Der Biber setzte sich seufzend hin und {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} nagte. Ritsch, ratsch. Ritsch, ratsch. Langsam und gleichmäßig. {woodpecker:live drum} Der Specht trommelte mit. {pinecone:pulse} Der Tannenzapfen rasselte mit. {frog:hop} Der Frosch quakte mit, und die Biene summte mit. {all:face happy} [excited] Das war Musik! {canvas:confetti} {all:hop x2} „Ein Hoch auf unsere Band!“ [happily] Und wie sie heißt? Die Ritsch-Ratsch-Band, natürlich.

fr-FR.title: La fanfare du pré
fr-FR.text: [excited] {beaver:enter} Castor voulait une fanfare. Une vraie fanfare du pré ! {beaver:face happy} {beaver:hop} « Qui sait jouer ? » a-t-il appelé. {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pic-vert s’est posé sur un tronc. « Moi, je fais le tambour ! » {woodpecker:live drum} {sfx:drum} Ra-ta-ta-TA ! {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to beaver} Pomme de pin est arrivée en roulant. « Moi, je fais la maraca ! » {pinecone:live rattle} Tchic-tchic, ont fait ses écailles. {bee:enter} {bee:go to beaver} Abeille est arrivée en bourdonnant. « Moi, je fredonne ! » {bee:live hum} Mmm-mmm. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Et du bord de la mare, Grenouille a lancé : « CROÂ ! » [curious] « Et toi, Castor, tu joues de quoi ? » {beaver:face sad} Castor a regardé son bâton. « Moi, je sais juste ronger », a-t-il dit. Alors ils ont joué. Ra-ta-ta ! Tchic-tchic ! Mmm ! CROÂ ! {all:face surprised} {all:wobble} Tous en même temps, et chacun à sa vitesse. [laughs] Quel tintamarre ! Castor s’est assis en soupirant et {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} s’est mis à ronger. Cric, crac. Cric, crac. Lentement, sans s’arrêter. {woodpecker:live drum} Pic-vert a tambouriné avec lui. {pinecone:pulse} Pomme de pin a fait tchic-tchic avec lui. {frog:hop} Grenouille a croassé avec lui, et Abeille a fredonné avec lui. {all:face happy} [excited] C’était de la musique ! {canvas:confetti} {all:hop x2} « Vive la fanfare ! » [happily] Et son nom ? La fanfare Cric-Crac, bien sûr.

it-IT.title: La banda del prato
it-IT.text: [excited] {beaver:enter} Castoro voleva una banda. Una vera banda del prato! {beaver:face happy} {beaver:hop} «Chi sa suonare?» ha chiamato. {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Picchio si è posato sul tronco di un albero. «Io so suonare il tamburo!» {woodpecker:live drum} {sfx:drum} TOC-TOC-TOC! {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to beaver} Pigna è arrivata rotolando. «Io faccio le maracas!» {pinecone:live rattle} Ciac-ciac, facevano le sue squame. {bee:enter} {bee:go to beaver} Ape è arrivata ronzando. «Io so canticchiare!» {bee:live hum} Mmm-mmm. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} E dal bordo dello stagno, Rana ha gracidato: «CRA!» [curious] «E tu che cosa suoni, Castoro?» {beaver:face sad} Castoro ha guardato il suo bastoncino. «Io so solo rosicchiare», ha detto. Così hanno cominciato a suonare. Toc-toc! Ciac-ciac! Mmm! CRA! {all:face surprised} {all:wobble} Tutti insieme, e ognuno per conto suo. [laughs] Che baraonda! Castoro si è seduto con un sospiro e {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} si è messo a rosicchiare. Rosic, rosic. Rosic, rosic. Piano piano, sempre uguale. {woodpecker:live drum} Picchio ha tamburellato a tempo. {pinecone:pulse} Pigna ha scosso le squame a tempo. {frog:hop} Rana ha gracidato a tempo, e Ape ha ronzato a tempo. {all:face happy} [excited] Era musica! {canvas:confetti} {all:hop x2} «Evviva la banda!» [happily] E il suo nome? La Banda Rosic-Rosic, naturalmente.

zh-TW.title: 草地樂團
zh-TW.text: [excited]{beaver:enter}河狸想組一個樂團。一個真正的草地樂團！{beaver:face happy}{beaver:hop}「誰會演奏？」 牠大聲問。{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}啄木鳥停在樹幹上。「我會打鼓！」 {woodpecker:live drum}{sfx:drum}叩叩叩叩——叩！{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to beaver}松果滾了過來。「我會搖！」 {pinecone:live rattle}她的鱗片唰唰響。{bee:enter}{bee:go to beaver}蜜蜂嗡嗡地飛過來。「我會哼歌！」 {bee:live hum}嗯——嗯——。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙在池塘邊叫了一聲：「呱！」 [curious]「河狸，那你會演奏什麼？」 {beaver:face sad}河狸看看手上的木棍。「我只會啃東西。」 牠說。於是，大家開始演奏。叩叩叩！唰唰！嗯——！呱！{all:face surprised}{all:wobble}大家一起來，可是有的快、有的慢。[laughs]亂成一團！河狸嘆了一口氣，坐下來，{beaver:live gnaw}{sfx:gnaw}開始啃木棍。喀滋，喀滋。喀滋，喀滋。慢慢地，穩穩地。{woodpecker:live drum}啄木鳥跟著打鼓。{pinecone:pulse}松果跟著搖。{frog:hop}青蛙跟著呱呱叫，蜜蜂也跟著嗯嗯哼。{all:face happy}[excited]變成音樂了！{canvas:confetti}{all:hop x2}「樂團萬歲！」 [happily]那這個樂團叫什麼名字呢？當然是「喀滋喀滋樂團」囉。

zh-HK.title: 草地樂隊
zh-HK.text: [excited]{beaver:enter}海狸想組一個樂隊。一個真真正正的草地樂隊！{beaver:face happy}{beaver:hop}「邊個識玩音樂呀？」 牠大聲問。{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}啄木鳥飛到樹幹上。「我識打鼓！」 {woodpecker:live drum}{sfx:drum}篤篤篤篤——篤！{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to beaver}松果滾了過來。「我可以做沙槌！」 {pinecone:live rattle}她的鱗片沙沙作響。{bee:enter}{bee:go to beaver}蜜蜂嗡嗡嗡地飛過來。「我識哼歌！」 {bee:live hum}嗯——嗯——。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙在池塘邊大叫一聲：「呱！」 [curious]「海狸，噉你玩乜嘢呀？」 {beaver:face sad}海狸看看手上的木棍。「我淨係識咬嘢。」 牠說。於是大家一起演奏。篤篤篤！沙沙！嗯——！呱！{all:face surprised}{all:wobble}大家同時開始，卻有快有慢。[laughs]真是亂成一鑊粥！海狸歎了一口氣，坐下來，{beaver:live gnaw}{sfx:gnaw}咬起木棍來。咔嚓，咔嚓。咔嚓，咔嚓。慢慢的，穩穩的。{woodpecker:live drum}啄木鳥跟着打鼓。{pinecone:pulse}松果跟着搖。{frog:hop}青蛙跟着呱呱叫，蜜蜂也跟着哼。{all:face happy}[excited]變成音樂了！{canvas:confetti}{all:hop x2}「樂隊，好嘢！」 [happily]這個樂隊叫甚麼名字？當然就是——「咔嚓咔嚓樂隊」！
